description: This file defines the FollowersController class, which handles HTTP requests related to following and unfollowing user profiles in an ASP.NET Core application. It uses dependency injection for IMediator to send commands for follow/unfollow actions, and includes authorization attributes.

classes.name: FollowersController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core controller managing follow and unfollow profile actions, utilizing MediatR for command dispatching.

methods.name: Follow
methods.description: Handles POST requests to follow a user profile, sending an Add.Command via mediator.

methods.name: Unfollow
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to unfollow a user profile, sending a Delete.Command via mediator.
